race.description: Sub-Zero Air Conditioning Installation & Services Mdn Hcp
race.comment: Tricky race to kick off the card with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade, XPLAIN THIS (8) has started twice, running a good second on debut then finishing seventh last time over 1000m at Gold Coast. Has the addition of blinkers and expected to prove tough to beat. READY AS BAM (2) finished fourth last time out over 1050m at Rockhampton following a minor placing at Gatton when fresh from a spell the run prior. Ready to peak third-up and rates among the leading chances. MISHANI HONOUR (1) returns after six months in the paddock. Closed the last campaign with a fifth over 1200m at Gold Coast. Rates highly on best figures and should be right in this contest while fresh. NIGHT MARKET (9) finished third last time over 800m at Kilcoy when resuming from a spell, beaten 4 lengths. Will trim down second-up. In the right race this time and is sure to be prominent.
